name: LEADR
shortDescription: World-leader NFTs on Safrochain — wax-print likeness plus socio-economic Mandate weights. Soon on mainnet.
description:
LEADR is a Safrochain mainnet NFT collection of world leaders. Each piece pairs a stylized Likeness (African wax-print frame, geometric avatar, visible skin-tone and signature costume motifs) with Mandate weights — historical socio-economic axes such as state capacity, redistribution, openness, personalism, and militarization — so figures who share a silhouette (for example military dress) stay distinct in metadata and gameplay.

Design overview: users will mint or generate leaders when public sources can verify identity; art stays abstract (Ankara textile language, not photoreal). Confusable peers are separated by signature motifs and anti-traits (e.g. white tunic vs olive fatigue vs leopard cloth) plus divergent Mandate scores.

Ecosystem links (planned): LEADR is meant to sit beside geographically linked Safrochain assets and apps — regional stablecoins and IBC USDC corridors, localized Hub / Ekival / Safrimba experiences by city and language, and validator partnerships where Mandate traits can gate quests, allowlists, or regional campaigns. Mint and marketplace settlement target SAF (and optional stable pairs) on mainnet.

Status: Soon on Safrochain mainnet. Not live yet.
statusNote: Soon — Safrochain mainnet listing only. Collection and mint UX not live yet.
